## Review verdict

**Accept the source changes for gated validation; block merge and performance claims until the authorized build and tests run.** I found no definite defect in the reviewed diff from `bb53ac884c24d15f0c77b2dc43cace0e8e650c24` through commit `0c3433f44bbc8ba5340cfd590dff17aae85ae262` and the staged changes. This is a read-only verdict: I ran no configure, compiler, test, inference, or GPU command.

The lifetime path is coherent. [RecognitionGroups](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/common/uct_recognition_groups.hpp:11) requires event completion **and** host consumption before slot reuse. [issueGroup](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/common/uct_tensorrt.cpp:923) marks a slot queued before fallible submission; cancellation drains any queued group before input release, and exceptions enter whole-State retirement. Equal canvas and group size gate lookahead at [line 1015](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/common/uct_tensorrt.cpp:1015), avoiding context shape changes while prior work is queued. N1 still loops through eight neural calls per full group at [line 937](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/common/uct_tensorrt.cpp:937).

The [batched rectifier](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/cuda/uct_kernels.cu:360) repeats the scalar per-pixel expressions and uses a sample offset into `[N,3,48,W]`. The [batched argmax](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/cuda/uct_kernels.cu:454) retains the 256-lane invalid-value and lowest-index tie rules, with actual `[N,T,C]` stride; [compaction](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/cuda/uct_kernels.cu:502) retains the float `ceilf` consumed prefix, blank/repeat handling, and first confidence. All T rows are scanned. The three bulk copies use contiguous first offsets at [lines 980–986](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/src/common/uct_tensorrt.cpp:980). I found no new sorting, precision change, vectorized sampling, or padded-row skip.

**Validation gaps:** The new [headless retirement fixture](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/tests/uct_paddle_tests.cpp:196) substitutes deterministic throws for native copy/event failures; it does not execute the production TensorRT `issueGroup` failure path. The [CUDA comparison fixtures](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/tests/uct_paddle_tests.cpp:943) are registered but unrun, so exact bits, launch behavior, and real slot overlap remain unverified. The [measurement plan](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-fd5f4ac9/docs/uct_helper_batching.md:66) correctly keeps current-driver performance and output equivalence pending. Neither the earlier failed r1 attempt nor this review supplies hardware results.
